newsitems.title: Wo Long 2: Wings of Ember has a demo out, as Koei Tecmo carve an early 2027 release date into some hulking demons from Chinese mythology
newsitems.contents: Wo Long: Fallen Dynasty sequel Wo Long 2: Wings of Ember will release in March next year, devs Koei Tecmo have revealed as they've whipped out an alpha demo that you can give a go right away. Expect plenty of samurai sword slashing and rolling around the mythological or historical Chinese big man, plus some open battlefields to roam. Read more

newsitems.title: Wo Long 2 launches March 4, 2027! Limited-time alpha demo now available
newsitems.author: コーエーテクモゲーム
newsitems.contents: The release date for the dark Three Kingdoms action RPG Wo Long 2: Wings of Ember has been set for March 4th, 2027! Pre-orders are now live, and a new trailer depicting fierce battles against demons amid the chaos of the Three Kingdoms has also been released. Limited-time alpha demo now available: Explore part of Changban in the alpha demo, available until September 30th. Fight your way across a battlefield filled with Cao Cao's overwhelming forces, face the threat of powerful demons, and turn the tide against impossible odds. Players who complete the alpha demo will receive the Fledgling Phoenix Helmet for use in the retail version of the game. Don’t miss this opportunity to experience Wo Long 2 for yourself! Alpha demo system requirements: {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/46155652/7c9331e5ec2b826483cf613de6184db9694d619c.png Note: The system requirements for the alpha demo differ from those for the full game. We're also conducting a survey for the alpha demo, and we would love to get your feedback. https://www.gamecity.ne.jp/form/wolong2_trial_us Wishlist Wo Long 2 and follow our official social media channels to stay tuned for future updates!

newsitems.title: Wo Long 2: Wings of Ember announced for early 2027
newsitems.author: コーエーテクモゲーム
newsitems.contents: The new entry to the dark fantasy Three Kingdoms action RPG with over 5 million players has been announced to release early 2027! The dark fantasy Three Kingdoms action RPG begins anew, where players wield Chinese martial arts action that combines offense and defense, utilizing the "Deflect" technique to parry enemy attacks, and traverse battlefields teeming with monstrous Demon alongside heroes who have left their mark on history. The stage is set in the late Han Dynasty, a time of war and turmoil. It's an era of warring states, where the heroes of the Three Kingdoms vied for supremacy. A nameless champion fights on a vast battlefield, battling powerful generals and Demon. More information to come!
